meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Webex 聊天通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 Webex 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat channel into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex messaging to your application

howto.what: 执行后,Claude 会为项目添加 Webex 聊天通道:复制适配器文件、注册通道、安装固定版本依赖、运行构建与集成测试。不会自动完成 Webex 机器人创建和凭证填写,需你手动操作。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目添加 Webex 通道集成时触发。

say.text: 给这个项目添加 Webex 通道集成。
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册通道并运行构建。

say.text: 运行 add-webex 技能,接入 Cisco Webex。
say.note: 安装依赖并运行集成测试。

say.text: 用 add-webex 给项目加上 Webex 支持。
say.note: 之后会引导你配置 Webex 机器人。

howto.what_en: After running, Claude adds Webex chat support to the project: copies adapter files, registers the channel, installs a pinned dependency, runs build and an integration test. It does not create the Webex bot or fill in credentials for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Webex channel integration to the project.

say_en.text: Add Webex channel integration to this project.
say_en.note: Claude copies the adapter, registers the channel, and runs the build.

say_en.text: Run the add-webex skill to bring in Cisco Webex.
say_en.note: Installs the dependency and runs the integration test.

say_en.text: Use add-webex to add Webex support to my project.
say_en.note: Then it prompts you to set up the Webex bot.
